Changed the channel name: GA - Gender Affirmation Procedures (Resubmit) (Pending)
Honestly, I've gotten at least 30 flame mail TGs on this resolution given its expansion of LGBTQIA+ rights.
Changed the channel name: GA - Gender Affirmation Procedures (Resubmit)
Here's the TG since I sent it.
Thanks! :D
i unfortunately have to say i'm against
it's just sorta too wide a subject to enforce on a global scale when you think about it, as unfortunate as that is
Tbh I don't care, I'm voting FOR. As a trans person, this kinda legislation is something I'm going to fight tooth and nail for.
yeah that's fully understandable <3
It... disgusts me that this kinda thing is so heavily against.

People are against it for a wide variety of reasons, primarily those of which are *not* inherently transphobic. Please bear in mind **NationStates is a nation roleplaying community**, people act on the basis of "well what would my nation do / how would it react" and others do just act out of bigoted nature. I'm against because the proposal itself infringes on national sovereignty, and disregards deeprooted spiritual / religious values that may exist in some nations. I'm for the proposal in spirit, but I'm against because it wouldn't be realistically applicable if that makes sense.
Mnf… fair

For example, in the real world, you couldn't pass an international legislation that forces countries in the Middle East (for example, i'm just generalisng) to come out in full force support for LGBTQ+ individuals
In a right world, that would happen. But unfortunately, it doesn't
I just thought there’d be a bit more of a fight instead of it being mostly one-sided
Mhm
Don't be disheartened; in all honesty, and with all due respect to Simone, it's not a greatly written proposal.
Again, things like these are very, very difficult to pass on an international scale when you have so many nations. It makes the World Assembly extremely difficult to get things done in

For example, it's impossible to write up a resolution about coastline protection because you have to take into consideration landlocked nations, nations on planets that don't have oceans, or nations that purely just exist in space and nowhere else
Why would they vote on a proposal that doesn't apply to them at all?
Some nations may consist of species that can willingly change sex without the need for gender-affirming care or whatever (it sounds insane, but it probably exists in the NS multiverse, somewhere)
it's why i don't for one second consider WA authorship because people are so anal about resolutions

In Cappedore, conversion therapy is fully prohibited, self ID is allowed, however people need a diagnosis of gender dysphoria before they can receive gender affirming care, be eligible for gender reassignment surgery, etc. It's all free of charge, as per the Cappedorite Healthcare Institute, and can be given at any age. Why would my country be willing to give up its already functioning apparatus for something that'll just complicate matters?

Little Late but I think there may be a flaw with the proposal that's here:
In Section 3 (Denials) specifically in sub-section a it is stated 
"No state or entity may deny any treatment to anyone except on the grounds of mental competence."
Could not a state than logically just claim that the person has mental problems freely and fully bypass the resolution all together and it be defacto useless?
Section 5 is there as well but again, a state could interpet it as a benefit to block people from getting those treatments they want due to not believeing in them being good.
It also depends on what the state interpreted to be “mental incompetence”
So a state could suggest that somebody with autism or ADHD is mentally incompetent and then refuse care
Which doesn’t seem right at all

I'd go further and say a state could say that EVERYONE lacks the mental competence in their area and would not be able to do it, might be restricted only to really high up officials who actually are competent by the states standard.
Aw it's going to be defeated? Bummer. I sometimes get a kick at seeing the GA queue get about 10-15 illegal repeals that are overly religious, natsov, or blogpost

Since the other side also realizes the GA cares more on the content of policies rather than the type of policies and always reacts as so, no matter the strength of the proposal.

It was also really kinda funny when I got some hate mail voting against the last repealed one of these I think.
"X should be repealed because God doesn't allow for this filth" and stuff like that?
Yeah it's kinda great :suiwheeze: There's always so many of them, 0 effort just clogging up the illegal pile
all because they just can't accept that the world's changing and there's nothing they can do to stop it... ffs

I see it more from that roleplay community stance as shared - like imagine some Sovereign Citizen type just make a laughing stock out of themselves proposing this behind the podium at a UN assembly. The misuse and dissonance is what really makes it sorta comedic. Like fanmail or hate mail in a moderation reporting system - it's just not where that goes.
I never realized I could probably play bingo with those proposals. "Does it break enough rules in a row to make a bingo?"
(does the WA have 24 rules so I can make a bingo card...hm...now these are real questions)
makes it hella boring to try and pass anything does it not?
because unless it is a repeal or so broad it applies to every conceivable nation it dies to natsov
whole concept of natsov seems a little ironic as well. why join a world organisation :derp:
welcome to WA
Against on basis of clause 2b / my statement bellow IC
Mental competence is governed by GA299, but if this gets resubmitted, I'd probably re-word it.
It's one of the two (alleged) loopholes people discovered, along with complaints about "entice anyone"

If you resubmit and re-word it I suggest you try and avoid any mention of a WA HQ, considering there was some opposition about that. (Its starting to look like maybe people just DONT want an HQ? Idk though)
If ya try a resubmit and rewording it probably would pass, maybe wait a bit before throwing it on though.
TEP votes FOR. Resolution defeated. (8-6-1-0)
